user_request: Investigate Meridian Electronics Co. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Baseline clean supplier check for a Tier 1 electronics manufacturer with current certifications, no incidents, and no sanctions matches.
notes: Regression case to confirm the pipeline does not over-flag a clean supplier.

user_request: Investigate Golden Thread Textiles. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Apparel supplier with two expired social-compliance certifications and an open labor board wage complaint layered on top of an unresolved labor rights NGO report.
notes: Tests compound risk scoring when multiple medium-severity signals stack; a UK-listed 'Golden Thread Textile Ltd' sanctions record should be evaluated and correctly dismissed as a name-only false positive (SAN-004).

user_request: Investigate Cobalt Basin Mining Ltd. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Cobalt mining supplier with an active child labor investigation, a fatal safety incident with broken chain-of-custody, an expired conflict-minerals certification, and a beneficial-ownership sanctions link on its parent company.
notes: Primary critical-path test case: must trigger UFLPA-style forced-labor reasoning, Dodd-Frank conflict minerals reasoning, and route to human review on the parent-company sanctions link (SAN-003).

user_request: Investigate Rhine Valley Chemicals GmbH. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Specialty chemicals supplier with full active certification coverage, strong ESG score, and REACH compliance on file.
notes: Confirms REACH-relevant regulation lookup is triggered without producing false risk flags.

user_request: Investigate Pacific Rim Assembly. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Electronics assembler with one resolved fire incident and one resolved one-day strike, both fully remediated with verified corrective actions.
notes: Tests that resolved historical incidents lower severity weighting relative to open incidents and do not force human review on their own.

user_request: Investigate Anatolia Agri Exports. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Agricultural exporter under active investigation for forced labor practices by a third-party recruitment agency, despite holding a valid Fair Trade certification.
notes: Tests that a valid certification does not suppress a credible, unresolved forced-labor allegation from a third-party labor recruiter.

user_request: Investigate Dhaka Weave Mills. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Textile mill with a critical open structural safety finding, a suspended ethical audit certification, and a resolved underage-labor incident from the prior year.
notes: Building-safety scenario modeled on real-world Bangladesh RMG sector risk factors; validates severity escalation on 'critical' incident severity alone.

user_request: Investigate Andes Copper Corp. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Copper miner with a resolved environmental spill, active Copper Mark certification, and strong recent ESG trend.
notes: Tests environmental-incident handling distinct from labor incidents; expects fine payment and regulator sign-off to count as verified remediation.

user_request: Investigate Shenzhen Circuit Works. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Electronics manufacturer with an expired RBA certification and an open audit finding describing a labor transfer program pattern associated with UFLPA forced-labor risk.
notes: Primary UFLPA regulation-matching test case; the compliance agent must connect the incident description to REG-001 without an explicit keyword match on 'Xinjiang'.

user_request: Investigate Nordic Timber Group. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Forestry supplier with full active FSC and PEFC certification, excellent ESG score, and no incidents or sanctions history.
notes: Best-in-class control case; also validates EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) applicability lookup for forestry commodities.

user_request: Investigate Lagos Textile Hub. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Small apparel supplier with zero certifications on file, an open wage-theft complaint, and no formal grievance mechanism.
notes: Tests the 'no data' case (absence of any certification record) is itself surfaced as a compliance gap rather than silently treated as compliant.

user_request: Investigate Volga Metals Trading. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Metals trader with an exact-match active OFAC SDN designation on both the company and its commercial director, plus an unresolved corruption investigation.
notes: Hard-stop scenario: any exact-confidence sanctions match should force human_review regardless of other scores; used to test that routing logic short-circuits on sanctions hits.

user_request: Investigate Bangalore Tech Components. Full due diligence across compliance, risk, and sustainability.
scenario_description: Electronics component maker in India with full active certification coverage, no incidents, and solid ESG performance.
notes: Second clean-supplier control case, differentiated geography, to guard against false positives tied to country-of-origin bias.

user_request: Check Silverline Semiconductors' incident and sanctions history and their sustainability performance. No need to review their certifications.
scenario_description: Ambiguous edge case: supplier has no incidents or sanctions and strong certifications, but very high absolute carbon emissions typical of semiconductor fabrication.
notes: Tests that the sustainability agent distinguishes industry-normalized emissions intensity from raw tonnage so semiconductor fabs are not unfairly penalized versus a small supplier.

user_request: Just check if Golden Thread Textiles has any expired or missing certifications. I don't need anything else right now.
scenario_description: Narrow tool-selection test on the same supplier as EVAL-002: only certifications were asked about, so only the Compliance Agent should run, even though this supplier also has real, discoverable incident and sustainability findings.
notes: Primary tool-selection test case. risk_level/route are best-effort predictions based on compliance findings alone (2 expired certs, both high severity observed in manual testing) -- a mismatch here is informative about how the Risk Analyst weighs a single dimension, not necessarily a pipeline defect.

user_request: Screen Volga Metals Trading against sanctions lists and check their incident history. Skip certifications and sustainability for now.
scenario_description: Narrow tool-selection test on the same supplier as EVAL-012: only the Risk Agent should run. The real OFAC sanctions match should still be found and should still force human review on its own.
notes: Tests that an exact sanctions match forces human_review even when it is the only dimension checked -- the hard-stop behavior should not depend on compliance/sustainability also having run.

user_request: What is Cobalt Basin Mining Ltd's sustainability and ESG performance? No need to check compliance or incident history.
scenario_description: Narrow tool-selection test on the same supplier as EVAL-003: only the Sustainability Agent should run, in isolation from the (separately, very serious) compliance and risk findings on this supplier.
notes: risk_level/route are best-effort predictions from sustainability findings alone (ESG score 24, no report on file, no science-based targets -- three high-severity findings observed in manual testing).

user_request: Check Nordic Timber Group's certifications and any reported incidents or sanctions. Sustainability data isn't needed for this check.
scenario_description: Narrow tool-selection test on a clean supplier: only Compliance and Risk should run. Since the supplier has no real issues in either dimension, this should resolve cleanly with no findings.
notes: Two-agent (not three, not one) tool-selection case on a clean supplier -- also exercises the deterministic zero-findings path in the Risk Analyst when only a subset of specialists ran.

user_request: Just check Lagos Textile Hub's certifications, nothing else.
scenario_description: Narrow tool-selection test combined with the missing-information/no-certs case from EVAL-011: only Compliance should run, and it should find zero certifications on file.
notes: Combines tool-selection and missing-information detection: compliance_agent alone should surface the total absence of certifications as a finding, per its own instructions, without needing any other specialist to run.

user_request: Check Andes Copper Corp's certifications and sustainability performance. Incident and sanctions history isn't needed right now.
scenario_description: Narrow tool-selection test on a moderate-profile supplier: Compliance and Sustainability should run, Risk should not, even though this supplier does have a (separately, already-resolved) environmental incident on file.
notes: Moderate ESG score (61) is a genuine judgment-call boundary case for the sustainability agent's 'only report genuine gaps' instruction -- useful for observing where that threshold actually sits in practice.
